svg.title: The Dapr threat model: trust boundaries and the flows that cross them
svg.desc: Four trust boundaries, each a dashed region, all on one vertical axis. At the top, the certificate authority holds a filesystem or Kubernetes secret above Sentry, joined by a flow labelled CA private key. In the middle, App A and App B each hold an app hexagon and a Dapr sidecar hexagon side by side, with an arrow from the app to the sidecar labelled Dapr API request and another back labelled Dapr API response; both stay inside the boundary. From each sidecar a line rises into Sentry, labelled CSR where it reaches Sentry and workload certificate where it returns to the sidecar. The two sidecars are joined by a line labelled mTLS API calls. At the bottom, a trust anchor injector boundary holds the injector, with a line to each sidecar labelled inject root certificate, and a run round the left of the picture back to the secret, labelled read root certificate.
